title: pauridiantha paucinervis subsp. lyallii
intro: Pauridiantha paucinervis subsp. lyallii, commonly known as Khat's relative, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It has been reported to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the management of conditions such as arthritis and certain types of cancer. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate the central nervous system, increase alertness, and enhance mental performance. Bioactive constituents of Pauridiantha paucinervis subsp. lyallii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
